sourceTitle: Saulkrasti starfall timelapse at Lighthouse — frame at 00:03
author: Alex Petunov
identityEvidence: Uploader names Saulkrasti in the individual CC video. Exact depicted structure independently matched to official Maritime Administration of Latvia List of Aids to Navigation (2015 edition updated May 2016), printed page 62, image 059, Skulte N mole beacon. Matching features are the wide tapering lower column, reduced neck, solid cylindrical red cap, broad pale reflective band below the cap and narrow external ladder. This is the 2016 structure, distinct from an earlier caged beacon shown in a 2011 third-party photograph; the authoritative contemporaneous register resolves the difference. Official register coordinates 57°19.06 N,24°23.98 E. The National Encyclopedia states Saulkrasti city territory reaches Zvejniekciems and Skulte port.
pixelReview: Actual native 1920x1080 frame inspected. Clean fixed-camera view of the Skulte north-mole navigation marker under dense visible stars and the Milky Way, with faint clouds at lower left. The tower surface, external ladder, cap, reflective band and graffiti remain sharp. No vehicle, windshield, streetlamp-only view, daylight sky or artificial darkening. Night timelapse speed is a video presentation change; selected frame preserves source photography.
changes: Resized without upscaling, cropped to 1200 × 675 and compressed as WebP. No day-to-night alteration.
licenseConditions: Individual watch metadata explicitly states Creative Commons Attribution licence (reuse allowed). Credit Alex Petunov and source video, link the licence, state frame extraction and any crop/resize. The source label does not state a licence version; none invented.

sourceTitle: A white church illuminated at night with festive lights
author: Matthew (@mharris97)
identityEvidence: The individual Unsplash page explicitly places the photograph in Salaspils, Latvia. Independently matched actual church pixels to the Salaspils municipality tourism photograph of Salaspils Mārtiņa Lutera evaņģēliski luteriskā baznīca at Rīgas iela 49/1, coordinates 56.8585,24.3467. Matching distinctive features: tall square white tower with narrow windows, steep metal spire with inset slit, stepped side roof, adjoining long nave with two levels of narrow rectangular windows and brick chimney. Official reference: https://visit.salaspils.lv/lv/ko-apskatit/salaspils/salaspils-kulturvesture/salaspils-luteranu-baznica/ . Official image used only for identification, not published. Earlier Roman Catholic church hypothesis rejected after actual-reference comparison.
pixelReview: Actual 3000×2000 source and final 1200×675 derivative inspected individually. Genuine black night sky, white church walls lit by fixed lights, glowing tower window and festive string lights across snow-covered garden. Main church, distinctive tower, cross and nave remain visible and clear in final crop. No windshield, vehicle interior, motion blur, day-to-night transformation or substituted city.
changes: Cropped original to remove excess foreground and sky, resized without upscaling to 1200×675 and compressed as WebP. No change to scene, lighting or time of day.
